stories.title: Maharashtra releases tentative 2027 CET schedule
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell has released its tentative schedule for 21 exams running from January to June 2027. Officials describe the dates as probable and suggest checking the website for updates. The schedule includes two attempts for 11 courses, including PCM and PCB.

stories.title: States consider adding board exam weightage to NEET UG
stories.summary: State governments are discussing reforms to the NEET UG medical entrance system, including a proposal to incorporate Class 12 board exam marks. The goal is to reduce reliance on a single entrance score. A task force is currently gathering suggestions from stakeholders regarding the potential changes.

When Will NTA Confirm CUET UG 2027 Exam Pattern Changes? Check for Latest Updates - Shiksha.com
Over 7 lakh students register for JEE Main 2027
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency reports that 7,04,316 candidates have completed registration and paid fees for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. Another 9,05,144 students have submitted forms but have not yet paid. Last year, the total number of candidates appearing for the exam exceeded 13 lakh.

stories.title: Big Change for SRMJEEE 2027 Aspirants: SRMIST Replaces Remote-Proctored Test with Centre-Based Exam - Shiksha.com
JEE Main 2027 registration deadline approaches
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has opened registration for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. Candidates must submit their applications through the MeriPehchan platform by November 22, 2026. The process requires uploading documents and paying the applicable fee to finalize the registration for the upcoming exam cycle.

stories.title: NTA confirms JEE Main 2027 syllabus remains unchanged
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has released the syllabus for the 2027 JEE Main exams. Despite the release of new documentation, the content remains identical to the previous year. No topics have been added or removed from the Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics sections for the upcoming sessions.

stories.title: MHT CET 2027: First Attempt Compulsory, Second Optional, Higher Percentile to Count - Shiksha.com
Maharashtra CET adds exams for nursing and management
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell has issued its tentative exam schedule for the 2027-28 academic year. The list includes 21 exams, with new additions for PGDM, PGCM, and GNM Nursing courses. Eleven of the entrance exams will offer students two separate attempts.

International student enrollment drops at US universities
stories.summary: New international student enrollment at US universities fell 15 percent for the fall 2026 semester compared to the previous year. A survey of over 800 colleges by the Institute of International Education cites rising education costs and changing visa policies as factors in the decline.

stories.title: Federal judge vacates four-year student visa limit
stories.summary: A federal judge in Boston has vacated a Department of Homeland Security rule that would have capped international student visas at four years. Judge F. Dennis Saylor described the proposed regulation as arbitrary and an abuse of discretion, preserving the existing duration of status framework for students.

stories.title: Court blocks fixed-term visa rule for students
stories.summary: A federal court has set aside a rule that would have limited international students to four-year stays in the US. The ruling preserves the longstanding duration of status framework, preventing new extension requirements and restrictions on academic mobility from taking effect. The government's motion for judgment was denied.

stories.title: Germany to scrap student visa waiting list for Bangladeshis from January - Banglanews24
Indian student enrollment in US graduate programs declines
stories.summary: The number of Indian students enrolled at US universities fell 6.5 percent to 339,435 during the 2025-26 academic year. Overall, US campuses saw a 9 percent decrease in international enrollment this fall, according to the latest Open Doors Report from the Institute of International Education.

stories.title: Court overturns Trump administration student visa rule
stories.summary: A federal judge has overturned a regulation that sought to replace duration of status policies with fixed four-year admission periods for international students. The ruling by Judge F. Dennis Saylor sets aside the Department of Homeland Security policy, allowing students to remain while making academic progress.

stories.title: Number of Hong Kong students in US down 27% over past 10 years - South China Morning Post
US court overturns restrictions on foreign student visas
stories.summary: A federal court has annulled restrictions that limited the duration of visas for international students and journalists. The ruling reverses a policy that mandated fixed terms for non-immigrant visas, finding the previous regulations were overly restrictive and detrimental to students seeking educational opportunities in the United States.

stories.title: US colleges report enrollment declines amid visa scrutiny
stories.summary: Colleges are reporting revenue losses as stricter vetting for F-1 student visas reduces foreign enrollment. While the government fights fraud in the program, universities are seeing a decline in international students, which is opening new job opportunities for domestic graduates and creating economic trouble for some institutions.

stories.title: Judge strikes down Trump-era visa duration rule
stories.summary: A US federal judge has vacated a rule that sought to restrict the duration of stays for foreign students and journalists. The court order ruled the policy was arbitrary, capricious, and an abuse of discretion, effectively ending the attempt to replace the existing status system with fixed terms.

stories.title: Court rejects fixed-term visa proposal for students
stories.summary: A federal court has struck down a rule that would have replaced the duration of status system with a four-year fixed admission period for F-1 and J-1 visa holders. Judge Dennis Saylor ruled the Department of Homeland Security policy was arbitrary and capricious, maintaining the current system for students.

stories.title: Judge blocks four-year limit on foreign student stays
stories.summary: A US federal judge has struck down a rule that would have imposed a four-year limit on the stay of foreign students. The ruling upholds the existing system that allows international students to remain in the country while maintaining status and making progress in their academic programs.

stories.title: Applications open for SC students scholarship scheme
stories.summary: The Central Government is accepting applications for the Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students for the 2026 to 27 academic year. Eligible students pursuing higher education at notified institutions can apply online through the National Scholarship Portal until November 30, 2026.

stories.title: Scholarship opportunities announced for Indian students
stories.summary: Students pursuing professional courses can apply for various scholarships for the 2026 to 27 academic year. Programs offer financial assistance up to ₹75,000 and fully funded coaching for competitive exams. Opportunities are available for meritorious students, women in engineering, and students from economically weaker families or with disabilities.

stories.title: TGBIE national merit scholarships update
Unclaimed scholarships and the role of imposter syndrome
stories.summary: The National Scholarship Providers Association reports that $100 million in private scholarships go unclaimed annually in the United States. Experts suggest that imposter syndrome, where students doubt their own abilities or accomplishments, often leads applicants to hesitate, procrastinate, or avoid the process entirely.

stories.title: Planning A Master's In UK? Check University Of Edinburgh's Scholarship Criteria - NDTV
CU Denver distributes $20 million in annual scholarships
stories.summary: CU Denver distributes approximately $20 million in scholarship funds each year to assist students balancing work and family obligations. The university states that these funds can be the difference between completing a degree or dropping out, as many students hold multiple jobs to pay for their education.

stories.title: SMACNA opens college scholarship applications
stories.summary: The Sheet Metal and Air Conditioning Contractors' National Association is accepting applications for the 2027 to 28 academic year. The program is open to full-time students at accredited four-year colleges, with a preference for those interested in careers connected to the sheet metal industry.

stories.title: Government offers $40,000 teaching scholarships
stories.summary: The federal government is offering up to 1,000 scholarships worth $40,000 for undergraduate teaching students starting in 2027. Education Minister Jason Clare stated that teachers do the most important job in the world. Recipients must commit to working in government teaching roles after graduation.

stories.title: Bishop’s University offers international student funding
stories.summary: Bishop’s University in Quebec is offering entrance awards and bursaries worth up to $17,000 annually for international students for the 2027 academic year. The institution provides more than $7 million in total financial assistance each year to support students pursuing undergraduate degrees in Canada.

stories.title: UGC offers postgraduate financial assistance
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission is offering a national scholarship for postgraduate studies in India. Selected students can receive ₹15,000 per month for 10 months, totaling up to ₹3,00,000 over two years. Applications for the 2026 cycle are open on the National Scholarship Portal until November 30.

stories.title: Oxford Law announces bursaries for 2027 to 28
stories.summary: The University of Oxford Faculty of Law is offering need-based bursaries of £20,000 for students admitted to its BCL and MJur programs for the 2027 to 28 academic year. Applicants must secure admission before submitting financial information for bursary consideration by the January 27 deadline.

stories.title: Funded international scholarships for South African students
stories.summary: Four fully funded international scholarships are available for South African students and researchers with deadlines before December 5, 2026. The awards cover tuition, housing, travel, and living expenses for programs at institutions including the University of Toronto, UC Berkeley, Cambridge, and various Swiss universities.

stories.title: Idris Isayev: Ten Azerbaijani universities ranked in QS top 1000 - Report.az
Chulalongkorn ranks 12th in ASEAN
stories.summary: Chulalongkorn University placed 12th in the QS Asia University Rankings 2027, making it the only Thai institution in the regional top 15. The university achieved an overall score of 82.5 out of 100. QS evaluates institutions based on 11 indicators, including academic and employer reputation.

stories.title: 11 PH universities make 2027 QS sustainability rankings - Inquirer.net
Sejong University leads Korea in citation rankings
stories.summary: Sejong University ranked first in Korea for the share of its papers among the world’s top 10 percent most-cited publications in the 2026 CWTS Leiden Ranking. Under fractional counting, 14.4 percent of its papers reached this threshold. The university has held this domestic position for four consecutive years.

stories.title: IIT Delhi enters global top 200 for sustainability
stories.summary: The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is India’s highest-ranked institution in the QS World University Rankings: Sustainability 2027, placing 194th globally. IIT Kharagpur followed at 224th and the University of Delhi at 237th. A total of 99 Indian universities featured in the latest edition of the rankings.

stories.title: IIT Delhi leads Indian sustainability rankings
stories.summary: IIT Delhi secured the 194th spot globally in the QS Sustainability Rankings 2027, leading all Indian institutions. IIT Kharagpur and the University of Delhi were ranked 224th and 237th respectively. India recorded the highest improvement among the top five most represented higher education systems in the global list.

stories.title: University of Wollongong ranks 9th in Australia
stories.summary: The University of Wollongong ranked equal ninth nationally in the 2026 Australian Financial Review Best Universities Ranking. The institution placed in the top 11 for teaching and equity, and 16th for research. Vice-Chancellor Max Lu described the result as a reflection of the university’s strength as well-rounded.

stories.title: QS sustainability rankings place IIT Delhi in top 200
stories.summary: IIT Delhi is the top-ranked Indian institution in the QS World University Sustainability Rankings 2027, reaching 194th place globally. IIT Kharagpur and Delhi University followed at 224th and 237th. India recorded 99 entries in the rankings, down from 103 in the previous year.

stories.title: Sookmyung University integrates AI into curriculum
stories.summary: Sookmyung Women’s University is integrating humanistic values into engineering, life sciences and artificial intelligence to promote interdisciplinary research. Founded in 1906, the institution is marking its 120th anniversary this year. The university aims to cultivate talent capable of navigating the evolving demands of the current era.

stories.title: Sungkyunkwan University expands research partnerships
stories.summary: Sungkyunkwan University is strengthening industry ties and expanding partnerships in AI and quantum research. The 628-year-old institution traces its history to the Joseon Dynasty. It currently combines its traditional academic heritage with modern industry-academia collaboration to maintain its status as a research-intensive institution.

stories.title: Jeonbuk National University plans AI college
stories.summary: Jeonbuk National University plans to establish a College of AI in 2027 as part of an effort to expand student-centered research. The university ranked first among regional national institutions in the Korean Standard-Service Quality Index for 2026. It currently uses project-based learning to link classroom study with industry.

stories.title: Ewha Womans University expands global research
stories.summary: Ewha Womans University has maintained research networks with 1,021 institutions across 74 countries as of August. Its Global Excellence Program recently selected 31 research groups to host 41 international scholars. The university works with companies to support technology commercialization and build workplace expertise for its students.

stories.title: Siblings secure civil service roles
stories.summary: Bhopal-based siblings Aaditya Mishra and Pallavi Mishra have become IPS and IAS officers respectively. Their success is attributed to family support and a 25-year period of sacrifice by their father. The story highlights the role of collective family efforts in achieving professional goals within the civil service.

stories.title: South Korea tightens exam security
stories.summary: Proctors will inspect glasses and seal shirt buttons with stickers during South Korea's college entrance exams this Thursday. Authorities are deploying 8,400 additional supervisors to prevent cheating. The measures respond to concerns that artificial intelligence and smart devices are making fraud more difficult to detect during the event.

stories.title: Telangana to merge intermediate education
stories.summary: Telangana plans to integrate Classes 11 and 12 into the school system starting in the 2027 to 28 academic year. The restructuring will end a 55-year administrative separation between schools and junior colleges. The new framework will group students from nursery to Class 12 into primary, secondary and senior secondary

Princeton committee reviews orientation changes
stories.summary: The University Student Life Committee met to discuss changes to orientation programming following administrative proposals. Proposed shifts to small-group experiences were paused on November 9 after receiving backlash from students and alumni. The committee is now reviewing transparency and consultation processes for future administrative decision-making.

stories.title: Telangana SSC Exam Dates 2027: Schedule Awaited - Shiksha.com
MCC to release NEET PG round 2 seat allotment results
stories.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee will publish the round 2 seat allotment results for NEET PG 2026 today at mcc.nic.in. Candidates are required to download their allotment letters and report to their assigned institutes between November 18 and November 24. The schedule remains firm for all participants.

stories.title: NEET PG 2026 Round 2 Result PDF Download (November 17) - Shiksha.com
AI malware used to cheat on digital SAT exams
stories.summary: The College Board identified four test takers using malware called Auto SAT to bypass digital security. The software sent questions to an AI chatbot, which returned answers directly to the test screen. The program reportedly provided both multiple choice and open ended responses for a fee.

CLAT 2027 admit card release date remains unconfirmed
stories.summary: The Consortium of NLUs has not yet confirmed the release date for the CLAT 2027 admit cards. Students will need their application number and password to access the documents once they are available online. The exam is still scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026.
